title: my strength when I am weak

verses.text: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

Then Nehemiah told them, “Go and eat what is rich, drink what is sweet, and send out portions to those who have nothing prepared, since today is holy to our Lord. Do not grieve, for the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

caption:
Some days you reach the end of your strength and there is still a day left.

Grace does not wait for you to be strong again. It meets you in the weakness you would rather hide, and the power that holds you was never yours to begin with. Your heart may fail. God does not.

2 Corinthians 12:9, Psalm 73:26, Nehemiah 8:10 (BSB)
